accepted.text: Internal gravitational forces sum to zero so total x-momentum must stay constant.
Internal gravitational forces sum to zero so total y-momentum must stay constant.
Central internal forces exert no torque about the origin so total angular momentum must stay constant.
Six bodies of at most mass 20 and speed 10 cannot exceed 1200 in total x-momentum.
Six bodies of at most mass 20 and speed 10 cannot go below -1200 in total x-momentum.
Six bodies of at most mass 20 and speed 10 cannot exceed 1200 in total y-momentum.
Six bodies of at most mass 20 and speed 10 cannot go below -1200 in total y-momentum.
Positions in [0,20]x[0,12] with per-body momentum at most 200 bound total angular momentum above.
Positions in [0,20]x[0,12] with per-body momentum at most 200 bound total angular momentum below.
Softened potential with eps 0.3 bounds the most negative possible total energy for the allowed masses and G.
Energy available from initial motion plus infall into the softened well cannot accelerate any body beyond a few thousand.
Pairwise distances are non-negative by definition.
